messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV2 — spike in 5xx rate and tail latency on `prompt-routing-new-endpoint` (canary). Auto-alerting from latency-watch.

amanda_oncall: seeing it in the dashboard now — ~18% 5xx over the last 3m, p95 jumped to 3.8s. Canary only ~3% traffic but errors are customer-facing. Paging SRE.

jamie_sre: on it. pulling logs + tracing. any recent deploys?

lucas_dev: deploy completed ~10m ago for the mux refactor. Rolling back is an option but prefer FF kill first if safe.

priya_prod: Agreed — risk of wider rollback. Can we flip the feature gate for the canary slice to force traffic to stable-route? If so, do it and confirm customer impact.

amanda_oncall: prepping the kill. Using admin UI now: `FeatureGate: prompt-routing-new-endpoint` -> set mode=off for canary-slice.

amanda_oncall: ran command: `/ff set prompt-routing-new-endpoint canary false --reason "urgent: canary 5xx spike"`

incident-bot: FeatureGate change submitted by amanda_oncall. Request ID: fg-20260317-582.

jamie_sre: metrics dropping after flip — 5xx rate from 18% -> 2.1% in last 30s. p95 down to 640ms. Traces show NPE in new mux path, likely unhandled null in upstream router.

lucas_dev: thanks — reproducing locally. I see a race in `route_selector` when session metadata is missing. Pushing a hotfix branch but should not need immediate deploy if we keep canary off.

ivy_support: opening customer ticket list — two major customers reported degraded responses on integrations. Raising with CS.

priya_prod: Notifying account teams: @accounts-signal for the two impacted customers, asking for outreach and ETA.

amanda_oncall: Confirm handover — I'm oncall for another 30m then handing to eve_oncall. Current state: canary cut, fallback to stable-route, latency normalized, no ongoing deploys.

jamie_sre: creating a short incident bridge for postmortem and rollback decision. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/fg-20260317-582

eve_oncall: taking over oncall. Thanks @amanda_oncall. I'll monitor for regressions and coordinate dev fix deploy if needed.

lucas_dev: will queue hotfix PR and request a canary redeploy once tests are green. Plan: patch null-check + add metrics guard.

amanda_oncall: before handoff — add steps to incident doc: 1) FF already toggled off for canary 2) stable-route healthy 3) customers informed 4) dev working on fix 5) watch p95 & 5xx for 30m post-handoff.

ivy_support: Customers notified. Ticket IDs: #C-9871, #C-9992. CS flagged potential SLA credits; tracking with finance.

priya_prod: Good capture. I'll schedule a postmortem session tomorrow 10:00am PT; invites to SRE, dev, product, and CS.

jamie_sre: Adding a short telemetry note: enable extra KV cache logs for the next canary to catch missing metadata cases.

eve_oncall: monitoring — p95 steady ~600ms, 5xx ~1.8%. Keeping the canary gate off until hotfix validated. Will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident fg-20260317-582 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring.

amanda_oncall: handing off. all good from my side.

eve_oncall: acknowledged. I will take the bridge and coordinate the redeploy after PR approval.

lucas_dev: PR opened: GH#4521. Tests green in CI. Requesting canary redeploy when authorized.

priya_prod: Authorize canary re-enable only after SRE signs off on telemetry and we have a rollback playbook ready.

jamie_sre: agree. I'll validate traces and approve when rollout guardrails are in place.

ivy_support: Closing loop with customers after final resolution.

incident-bot: Timeline note appended to fg-20260317-582: canary killed at 1768532150, mitigation confirmed at 1768532220.

eve_oncall: leaving a final note: monitor window until 1768535950 (1 hour). If stable, move to postmortem and root cause.

amanda_oncall: thanks team.
